As an action, you can dart across the battlefield, striking up to six creatures you can see within 30 feet. You move to each target in turn without provoking opportunity attacks, then return to your starting space. Each target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 8 + your attack bonus with your weapon) or take your weapon's normal damage — half as much on a success. If you're wielding a separate weapon in each hand that you're proficient with, each save is made with disadvantage, and a creature that fails also takes extra damage equal to your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum 1), if that modifier isn't already included.

You must complete a short or long rest before using this feature again.
